h1: Build a TikTok UGC Ad From a Product Link
lead: Make a UGC-style TikTok ad in minutes, shaped for current trends, the vertical format, and the buyers you want to reach.
summary: You leave with a tall TikTok ad, a spoken voice, captions, and one reason to buy.

paras: Catch a TikTok trend while it is fresh: turn one product and one reason to buy into an ad you can post in minutes.

paras: Paste your product link, pick an AI actor, then export a vertical TikTok ad you can publish.

sections.h2: Skip the Film Crew on the First Ad
paras: The opening shows the cream doing something a shopper recognizes, while the tube stays in frame.
Skip the influencer fee and the production crew: make your first TikTok ad from the product photo you already have.
The next opening can be a different first line on the same photo. You get that test without booking another morning.
A shop that also sells in another language can keep the scene and replace the spoken line. The scene stays the one you approved.

sections.h2: Make More Versions From One Photo
paras: The tube is on screen while the shopper is still watching. That is the opening.
Make more TikTok ad versions from the same product photo by changing the presenter or opening line, without waiting on a creator.

Match the length to the motion. Six seconds fits one motion. Ten fits a short demo. Fifteen fits a simple sequence. Thirty fits a longer one. A video is 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, or 120 for 30.
Captions and the song live in this editor. When the words sit clear of the tube, this pass is done.

sections.h2: Where to Post the TikTok Ad
paras: Download a polished vertical TikTok ad you can post, then choose the right crop for each other place you publish.
TikTok gets the 9:16 file, with the sunscreen on screen at the open. The [TikTok ads](page:plat-tiktok) page has the size detail.
Instagram Reels plays that same tall shape. [Instagram](page:plat-instagram) covers the feed next to Reels.
Facebook Reels stays tall, and the feed gets a square. See [Facebook](page:plat-facebook).
YouTube Shorts uses 9:16 again, with the words clear of the edges. [YouTube Shorts](page:plat-youtube-shorts) is that shape.
A product page on your store can hold the video where shoppers land after they tap.
A listing can show the same tube in a video beside the still. Sizes for every placement are in [ad sizes by platform](page:guide-ad-sizes-by-platform).
sections.alt: Adult hands hold a plain peach sunscreen tube beside a notebook on a bright desk.

faq.q: What is a practical way to make a TikTok ad?
faq.a: Start with a product photo or link, then make a vertical video with a clear opening. You can create a TikTok ad without filming.

faq.q: What do I gain by making the ad this way?
faq.a: You can make a TikTok ad in minutes and skip creator and filming costs. Try several openings to find what works for your buyers.

faq.q: How quickly can a shop get a first TikTok ad?
faq.a: You can make your first TikTok ad in a few minutes. Add a product link or photo, then choose the message, voice, and vertical format.

faq.q: Can I make branded TikTok visuals from my own photo?
faq.a: Yes. Use your product photo and choose your brand colors and message. Make several versions to see what gets attention.

faq.q: Can the ad match my shop colors and spoken line?
faq.a: Yes. Set your colors, spoken message, and captions for the ad. Keep the product clear on a phone screen.

faq.q: Can I aim different versions at different buyers?
faq.a: Yes. Change the opening, actor, or tone for each buyer group. Compare the results in your TikTok ad account.

faq.q: Can I test openings before I book a shoot?
faq.a: Yes. Make several openings from one product photo in minutes. Test the ads before paying for a filmed campaign.

faq.q: How does a product page become a TikTok ad?
faq.a: Paste the product page to bring in its photos and details. Choose an actor, review the message, and make a vertical video with captions.

faq.q: What does a TikTok ad look like from one product photo?
faq.a: It becomes a vertical video showing your product with a short spoken message. You can use different openings to test what buyers watch.
